targeted.evidence: git diff --cached --name-status shows only .github/workflows/publish.yml; a single hunk adding one gate step that mirrors publish-ios-channel.yml, no other line touched

no_new_vulnerability.evidence: the gate only adds a fail-closed refusal using GitHub's $GITHUB_SHA (a 40-hex env var, not ${{ }} interpolation) and origin/main from the authenticated checkout, so no command/expression injection and no new surface

behaviour_unchanged.evidence: the only change to accepted input is turning away off-main refs at the publish sinks, which is the intended fix; legitimate on-main tags and dispatches still build/push/sign/release unchanged

tests_run: none possible: no Go toolchain on this box, and the Go suite does not exercise .github/workflows; verifier probe (not a project test): python3 yaml.safe_load(publish.yml) parsed, gate confirmed at step index 1 before setup-go, go test, build-push, cosign sign and the release

attack_paths.text: Anyone with tag-push (write) access can tag an already-reviewed on-main commit with an arbitrary version and publish that major; inherent to tag-driven releasing, requires write access and builds only reviewed on-main code, pre-existing and unrelated to this finding
